Beat 6: Founding Arts in the Armed Forces to bring live theater to military bases, he never forgot his fellow service members.

Beat 7: Delivering powerhouse performances in Marriage Story, BlacKkKlansman, and Ferrari, his raw intensity commands every frame.

Beat 8: **Was Marriage Story, BlacKkKlansman, or Star Wars Adam Driver's finest screen performance?**
posts.comment:
**The secret behind Hollywood's fiercest Marine-turned-actor:**
• Enlisted in the U.S. Marine Corps as an 81mm mortarman after 9/11, serving for nearly three years before a medical discharge.
• Was rejected by Juilliard on his first audition before returning after the Marines and graduating in 2009.
• Earned consecutive Oscar nominations for BlacKkKlansman and Marriage Story.
